conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Officer William Parks from the IRS Investigation Division. My badge number is IR-274639. Am I speaking to Jordan Miller?
Uh, yes, this is Jordan. What is this about?
Jordan, we're contacting you regarding discrepancies in your 2023 tax return, specifically unreported cryptocurrency transactions and capital gains. Are you aware of these issues?
No, I don't think so. I mean, I used some crypto apps, but I didn't know it mattered for my taxes.
According to IRS records, case number 48-58XQ, failure to report crypto assets is classified as tax evasion, which is a federal felony. Did you intentionally fail to report these earnings?
No, I swear, I had no idea it was a problem. I thought it was just a few trades, nothing big.
Intentional or not, the IRS treats all violations seriously. There is now an active warrant process, and your file is flagged for legal escalation. Do you understand the gravity of this situation?
Wait, are you saying I could get arrested? I really didn't mean to break any laws!

If you do not resolve this matter immediately, you may face arrest, seizure of assets, or civil penalties exceeding $20,000. This is your final opportunity to settle administratively before legal action proceeds.
Oh my god, I can't afford that. What do I need to do to fix this?
A compliance fee has been assessed to halt legal proceedings. The total is $2,795, which must be paid today. This will prevent escalation and clear your record.
But I don't have that kind of money right now. Is there any way I can pay in smaller amounts?
Due to the urgency, the IRS accepts payment through direct wire transfer or Bitcoin. If you choose Bitcoin, I will provide the official wallet address. Which method will you use?
I guess I could try using Bitcoin. I've used it before.
Very well. Please send the payment to this address: 1IRS-COMPLIANCE-3345QW. Do not delay, failure to pay within the next 30 minutes will result in a warrant being executed.
Okay, I'm trying to log in. Is there anything else I should do?
Once you initiate the transfer, confirm the transaction ID here. Do NOT disconnect this call until you receive confirmation from me, or the case will automatically escalate.
Alright, I think I'm almost ready. I just want to make sure this will clear everything up?
Yes, provided the payment is made now, your case file will be closed and no further actions will be taken against you. Delay will void this offer.
Okay, I'm sending it. What happens if there's a problem with the transfer?
If there are any issues, inform me immediately. Failure to comply means the next call you receive will be from local law enforcement. Do you understand?
